dedupe_keys.name: depuratori scarichi civili ed industriali condotte di scarico

description: Depuratori, scarichi civili ed industriali, condotte di scarico is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservizi.regione.liguria.it. The location of the civil discharges, their treatment centres, industrial discharges and underwater discharges surveyed by the Region, Arpal and the Provinces as part of their institutional activities are reported. The cartographic information is derived from the regional information system on discharges, which includes personal and technical data. The level update is dynamic. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Dataset Display Service: Purifiers, civil and industrial discharges, discharge pipes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include open data, humanGeographicViewer, AMBIENTE, CARTE TEMATICHE. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2015-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
